fact: The World Bank article says the Merankabandi CORE-MIS is hosted by the government at SETIC, where project and government teams manage the production and test environments, and local teams gained skills in setup, deployment and maintenance.
title: Burundi : Le projet d'appui aux filets sociaux adopte des technologies intelligentes pour renforcer l'impact social
